description: Three delay lines side by side with no connection between them, each with its own input, output and time control, plus a mixed and a polyphonic output

params.text: Sets the delay time of that line, from 1ms to 10 seconds
Attenuates and inverts the time jack beside it; at the top of its travel the jack is a volt to the octave on the delay time
Nothing in the module reads this knob; the feedback it scales is a value that is never carried from one sample to the next, so it stays at zero
Blends that line's delayed signal against its dry input

inputs.text: Shifts that line's delay time exponentially, scaled by the trimmer beside it

outputs.text: That line's delayed and dry signals blended by its own mix knob
The three lines summed and scaled to a third
The three lines as one three-channel polyphonic cable

notes: nothing is normalled between the three lines, so each needs its own input, and one signal fed to all three gives three taps of it
Rack's bypass passes each input straight to the output below it
